## Spec

members: the `labels_leaves` per-leaf admission walk (observation-shaping

## Requirements

1. `labels_leaves` per-leaf admission walk over observation shaping — every
   leaf admitted or the dispatch refuses typed.
2. The remedy consume path — a `remedies.taken` consumes through the ingress
   surface; the re-dispatched effect carries the remedy attestation; durable
   rows both sides.
3. The produce-time `FlowInputs.shape_endorsed` stamping caller on dispatch
   inputs.
4. DF-S2.7-1 discharged.

## Plan / implementation

- `crates/hh-env/src/leaf_admission.rs` (new): the per-leaf walker —
  enumerates result leaf positions against `output_schema` over the
  admitted-keyword subset (`properties`/`items`/`additionalProperties:<schema>`),
  bounded (1024 leaves, depth 64), refuses `unchecked_keyword:<kw>`,
  `uncovered:<path>`, `no_shaped_result`, `malformed_result`,
  `no_leaf_grammar`, `budget`. Structural paths only — never leaf bytes.
- `crates/hh-env/src/dispatch.rs`: leaf walk wired after shaping, before
  the observation mints — success stamps `leaves[]`; failure flips
  `observed{status: error{conflict{admission_leaf:*}}}` + a
  `recorded{admission: leaf_refused, leaf}` row (post-commit `refused`
  is lifecycle-illegal — ADR-0344 D1). Remedy consume: verify
  `DispatchInput.remedy_taken` against durable `decided{remedy_taken}`
  (canonical equality) + exactly-once vs `authorized{remedy_taken}`;
  restate on `authorized`. `shape_endorse` take: mint
  `action.param.anchored` (param's own label as honest `from`) then
  `security.label.endorsed{basis: validator, capacity_bits,
  robustness_inputs, subject_ref: <anchor>}`; apply the endorsed `to`
  label to the proposal's `param_labels[param]` + `shape_endorsed`
  (kernel-derived, never caller claim); `remedy_inapplicable:*` when the
  endorsement cannot mint (unbounded schema, over `cap_max`,
  non-`external` subject, `NoLabelIncrease`). `shape_endorsed_params`
  folds durable validator endorsements args-scoped through the anchor's
  `args_canonical_hash` — an endorsement never launders across
  re-supplied args (ADR-0344 D3).
- `crates/hh-env/src/events.rs`: `leaves`/`admission`/`leaf` on the
  observation-recorded codec; `action.param.anchored` event writer;
  `remedy_taken` on `authorized`; closed-set field tables extended.
- `crates/hh-env/src/egress.rs`: the egress respond path gains the same
  `remedy` arms (decoding + `decided{remedy_taken}` mint).
- `crates/hh-embed-schema/src/{types,lib}.rs`: `PermissionOutcome.remedy`
  member; artifacts regenerated (`EXPECTED_SCHEMA_HASH`
  `227f…` → `6942…`; `generated.rs`, `hh-embed-1.schema.json`,
  `compat-1.matrix.json`).
- `crates/hh-embed/src/work.rs`: `respond_permission` remedy arm —
  decode the closed `Remedy` sum (`malformed_remedy:*`), membership-gate
  vs `pending.request.remedies` (`OptionNotOffered`), `approval` takes
  decide `allow` (I-F6 R4, `scope = once`), other kinds
  `deny{reason: remedy:<kind>}`; `decided{remedy_taken}` minted
  (ADR-0344 D5).
- `crates/hh-monitor/src/approval.rs`: `ResponseChoice::Remedy` decode +
  the deciding-response legitimacy path.
- `crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs`: `action.param.anchored` registered
  (durable, provenance-required, non-audit — the endorsement's honest
  subject provenance; hosted lowering `hint`); `remedy_taken` admitted on
  the audit-grade `action.effect.authorized` partition.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0344` authored; `docs/adr/README.md` regenerated via the
  index script.
